name: JioHotstar
description: JioHotstar is the OTT platform of JioStar, an India-registered JV (Reliance 56%, Disney 37%, Bodhi Tree 7%) formed Nov 14, 2024 from the merger of Star India and Viacom18. Consolidated via Reliance Industries (NSE/BSE: RELIANCE); Disney equity-accounts its 37% stake.

stock.note: Not separately listed; consolidated into parent Reliance Industries (RELIANCE.NS). Disney (NYSE: DIS) equity-accounts its 37% stake.

breakdown.label: Onerous sports-contract provision (FY26, down from ₹25,760cr in FY25)

marketing_spend.derivation: Files with MCA but no discrete advertising line surfaced; JioStar is not individually named in PMAR's top-10 as a standalone entrant. OTT/broadcast players typically spend ~5-8% of revenue on marketing/subscriber acquisition; on ₹31,048 crore FY26 revenue this models to ~₹1,550-2,480 crore, elevated by IPL 2025 and the JioHotstar launch push.

business_updates.headline: FY26 turnaround to ₹3,210 crore net profit from near-breakeven FY25
Disney's India equity loss narrowed to $64m for the quarter ended Mar 28, 2026 (from $103m)
Scaled subscriber base on IPL 2025 and ICC Champions Trophy coverage
